request:
Which classes name JupyterMixin (from rich/jupyter.py) directly as a base class but do not define their own __rich_measure__ method in their class body? Give each class's symbol ID.

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string).
explanation: Finds class bases that resolve to the JupyterMixin class defined in rich/jupyter.py, then excludes classes whose own class body defines a __rich_measure__ method (a direct method, not one nested in an inner class). Returns the symbol IDs of the remaining classes.
sql: SELECT cb.class_symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = cb.base_symbol_id WHERE s.file_id = 'rich/jupyter.py' AND s.name = 'JupyterMixin' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.symbols m WHERE m.file_id = (SELECT file_id FROM code.symbols WHERE symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id) AND m.kind = 'method' AND m.name = '__rich_measure__' AND m.qualname LIKE (SELECT qualname FROM code.symbols WHERE symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id) || '.%' AND m.qualname NOT LIKE (SELECT qualname FROM code.symbols WHERE symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id) || '.%.%')
